bagPolicy.summary: Nationwide Arena enforces a no bag policy, allowing only specific exceptions. All bags are subject to x-ray screening.
bagPolicy.note: Medical bags and diaper bags are exceptions to the no bag policy.

parking.note: More than 15,000 spaces in surface lots and garages are within a 10-minute walk, and the arena links to an Arena District parking map. Parking can be bought in advance or on the day of the event, and prices vary by location. For accessible parking, the arena suggests the north entrance of the McConnell garage and the northeast entrance of the Front Street garage. All pick-ups and drop-offs are on West Street.
parking.summary: Over 15,000 spaces within a 10-minute walk. Buy in advance or on the day.

rideshare.note: Use West Street for all pickup and drop-off. Drivers must stay with their vehicles. Unattended vehicles may be towed.

concessions.note: The Nationwide Arena offers a variety of food and drink options, with alcohol sales strictly regulated according to Ohio law. Delaware North Sportservice is the primary vendor, ensuring compliance with ID checks for alcoholic beverages.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating is available on all levels of the arena at all price levels.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: There are no designated smoking areas at Nationwide Arena, and if you exit to smoke you won't be allowed back in.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Ticketmaster is the exclusive ticketing partner. The Box Office, at the corner of Nationwide Blvd. and McConnell Blvd., is open on event days for help and for buying any remaining tickets.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Nationwide Arena has entrances on McConnell Blvd. and Front St. Free wheelchair escorts are available at any entry point, with no advance arrangements needed.
